author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: So, every moment of time, I am either spending or I am investing.
editorial_note: Distinctive lecture metaphor retained without the surrounding causal or financial guarantees.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: The wide difference between thinking from and thinking of must be clearly seen and then see the wisdom in learning the art of thinking from a desired end.
editorial_note: Clean conceptual distinction retained independently of later deterministic assurance.

author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: So here, look out at your world, formulate your lovely aims in life and just ask yourself, “What would it be like were it true that I now embody that state? How would I feel?”
editorial_note: Standalone self-inquiry retained before the source returns to guaranteed externalization language.
